beta.notes:
## 0.1.0-beta.23

- Every library has a **Folders** tab, after Continue and before Collections: the library's folders on disk as the server lists them. OK on a folder opens its subfolders and files; a file opens as from any other view; Back comes out one folder at a time. Made for libraries of unmatched files (Plex "Other Videos", such as music videos kept in artist folders), which the other views show as one flat list.
- The library's Continue Watching tab now reads **Continue**, so all tabs fit on one row.
- A plain HTTP server connection is tried beside HTTPS; the server decides which is used (helps servers whose certificate fails to verify).
